method.overpass: POST to https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter (kumi/z mirrors were busy); queries kept within ~600-750 m of 47.5474,7.5896; 'out body geom'
method.coordinate_frame: Local ENU metres; station axis fitted by PCA on OSM platform polygons 5/6-11/12: track direction bearing -25.2 deg from east (WNW-ESE). 'offset' = lateral metres, + = north/Centralbahnplatz side, - = south/Gundeldingen side; 'along' = metres east of the PCA centroid (RailCity Passerelle is at along ~0).
method.distances: Haversine chain over OSM node coordinates (way vertices, stair end nodes, entrance nodes); no routing engine; stairs counted as horizontal chain only; +-10 % typical error, sector position of train NOT included.
other_sources: SBB Trafimage Bahnhofplan Basel SBB A4 PDF, dated 02/2026 (company.sbb.ch/content/dam/infrastruktur/trafimage/bahnhofplaene/plan-basel-sbb-a4.pdf)

Unterfuehrung_from_Gundeldingen.detail: OSM: tunnel footway 1005882100 (level -1, access=private) from the Schalterhalle basement (47.5472267,7.5897289) under platforms to ~platform 11/12 (47.5466854,7.5892784), with private ramps/stairs 1005882095-1005882099 up to platforms 3/4..11/12; it does not continue south. platform_layout.orientation: Through station; tracks run WNW-ESE. NORTH side = Centralbahnplatz/Schalterhalle/Centralbahnstrasse (city). SOUTH side = Gundeldingen (Meret Oppenheim-Strasse, Guetersstrasse), separated by a retaining wall. WEST end = Margarethenbruecke + Elsaesserbahnhof (SNCF) + provisional passerelle. EAST end = Ostfluegel, Post, Postpasserelle, Peter Merian.
platform_layout.all_level_0: All train platforms are OSM level=0 (same level as Schalterhalle). Both passerelles are level 1. Meret Oppenheim-Platz/-Strasse are a few metres above platform level (19 / 13-step flights).

platform_layout.platforms_19_20_explained: Real platform (Perron 19/20), opened 15 April 2024, built south of former through-track 19; track 20 is new; it is the southernmost platform of the station, directly below Meret Oppenheim-Strasse. Reached from (a) the RailCity Passerelle (new stair+escalator next to Coop Pronto, sector D), (b) the provisional west passerelle (sector G), (c) a RAMP from the Margarethenbruecke (west tip, sector H). Stationboard sample: platform 19 = S3 Olten, platform 20 = IC/IR Grenchen Nord.
platform_layout.sectors: From the SBB Innenplan 02/2026 (isometric, read visually; medium confidence): sector letters run A at the EAST end and increase WESTWARD. Platform 19/20: A-C east of RailCity Passerelle, D at the Passerelle, E, F, G (at provisional passerelle), H at the west tip near the Margarethenbruecke. Platforms 16/18 and 14/15: B at the Passerelle, C, D (at provisional passerelle), E at the west tip. Platforms 5/6-11/12: C at the Passerelle, D at the west end. SNCF 30-35: D (east, near provisional passerelle), C (west). OSM has no sector tags for train platforms (the 'platform_edge' refs E-H near Centralbahnplatz are tram platform edges).
platform_layout.nearest_to_margarethenbruecke_west: By direct access: 19/20 (ramp), 16/18 and 14/15 (stairs). Physically the SNCF platforms 30-35 also pass under the bridge but have no mapped access from it.

interpretation_of_commuter_hack.what_he_does: Tram 2 from Binningen stops at IWB at the south-west foot of the Margarethenbruecke, two stops (Markthalle, Bahnhof SBB; 3 min scheduled) before Centralbahnplatz. He gets off at IWB, goes ~110 m up onto the bridge's east (SE) sidewalk ('run over the bridge'), and takes the RAMP ('a passage') down onto the west tip of platform 19/20 ('gate 20' = Gleis 20) - entering the station from the west end instead of from Centralbahnplatz ('the other side'). From there he runs east along platform 19/20 ('run through the station') to his train, or up the provisional passerelle (98 m along the platform, opened Dec 2025) / RailCity Passerelle (213 m) to cross to another platform.
interpretation_of_commuter_hack.why_close_to_20_pays: Platform 19/20 needs 0 stairs (173 m from the tram door). 16/18 and 14/15 have their own stairs from the bridge (150-173 m, 1 flight down) or are 1-2 stairs away on the provisional passerelle. Each platform further north adds ~20-25 m of passerelle plus the same 2 level changes, and for 3/4 and 1/2 the west accesses do not help at all (must use RailCity Passerelle 690-820 m, or stay on the tram). Via the tram: 3 min ride + SBB's 6-min transfer budget from Centralbahnplatz (286 m + 2 level changes to 19/20), so ~9 min vs ~2-3 min running -> 'up to 5 min' saving is consistent.
interpretation_of_commuter_hack.gate_20_alternatives_considered: 'Gate 20' is not a station exit/entrance name; SBB names are 'Bahnhofeingang Gundeldingen', 'Ausgang Elsaessertor', etc. The stationboard platforms 19 and 20 are real. Most consistent reading: Gleis 20 = the platform the Margarethenbruecke ramp lands on.
interpretation_of_commuter_hack.app_model_hint: Sprint distance from IWB door = 173 m + along-platform distance to the train's sector (sector H = at ramp, D = at RailCity Passerelle ~215 m east, A = ~400 m east); if the target platform is not 19/20: add 98 m + 1 up + 1 down via provisional passerelle (or 1 down via bridge stairs for 16/18 and 14/15 if confirmed).

uncertainties: Margarethenbruecke stairs to 14/15 (30 steps) and 16/18 (27 steps) are attested only by OSM (ways 217965086/217965087, joined to layer-2 bridge footways); not visible in the SBB Innenplan (bridge is outside its frame) and not mentioned in press; opening hours/gates unknown.
Vertical heights are estimates from step counts (13, 19, 27, 30 steps) and typical rail clearance; OSM level tags are ordinal, not metres.

Sector letters were read from an isometric SBB drawing (Innenplan 02/2026), medium confidence; where a given train stops along the 400 m platforms is not derivable here - use the stationboard's platform+sector string.
SNCF platform polygons in OSM are large diagonal shapes; their mean lateral offsets are unreliable, so the SNCF position is taken from stop_position nodes (tracks 30/31/33/35 north-middle, west end).

The historic underpass is tagged access=private in OSM; Wikipedia says it is opened at peak hours from platforms 5-12 as an exit; whether it reaches Centralbahnplatz or only the hall basement is unclear; it does NOT reach Gundeldingen.
transport.opendata.ch 'connections' IWB -> Basel SBB returned a 0-s walk section (API artefact), so the SBB 8-min walk budget could not be reproduced from that endpoint.
OSM data is a snapshot (Overpass 2026-09-13); the provisional passerelle is by definition temporary (planned permanent Perronzugang Margarethen 2031-2037).
